馆票省下来，周末选择就会多一些。但“图书馆有博物馆通行证”只是入口，真正能用的是: Saving on museum tickets can open up more weekend choices. But a library pass program is only the starting point: you need a pass matching your eligibility, date, and group size. Start October planning with your own library rather than collecting cards for one popular venue.
先选自己符合资格的图书馆系统: Start with a library system where you qualify
旧金山 SFPL：Discover & Go 面向居住在 San Francis: San Francisco SFPL: Discover & Go is for library users who live in San Francisco. Having an SFPL card does not automatically qualify you for this resident benefit.
San José SJPL：最低预约年龄为 14 岁，部分场馆要求 16 岁或: San José SJPL: the minimum reservation age is 14, with some venues requiring 16 or 18. Teen, Student, Limited Borrower, and certain other card types are ineligible. Check your card type first.
Berkeley Public Library：限居住在 Berkeley、年龄: Berkeley Public Library: available to cardholders age 14 or older who live in Berkeley. Other East Bay, Peninsula, and North Bay residents should find their own system in the participating-library list.
把十月票安排成四步: Four steps to an October visit
第一步：先选可出行的日期，再看有票的场馆。收藏页有这个馆，不代表这个周末还有名额: Step 1: choose a date you can go, then check venues with available passes. A venue in the directory may have no passes left for that weekend.
第二步：打开具体票种条款，核对成人和儿童人数、持票人年龄、是否含特展，以及是否还: Step 2: read the actual pass terms for adult and child counts, pass-holder age, special-exhibition coverage, and any separate timed reservation.
第三步：按出票说明准备凭证。要求打印的票要打印，不能自行认定手机截图通用；带齐票: Step 3: prepare the proof specified by the pass. Print passes that require paper; do not assume a phone screenshot is accepted. Bring any library card or identification required on the pass.
第四步：只加一处附近散步或午餐，写出交通与最晚返程。临时去不了，按本馆可取消规则: Step 4: add only one nearby walk or lunch stop and plan transport and the latest return. If plans change, release the pass promptly under your library’s cancellation rules.
9 月就能查十月，10 月 1 日也值得再看: Check October now, then look again on October 1
SJPL 说明月初更新可见月份，10 月 1 日可看到十月至十二月；十月票可能早: SJPL says the visible months update at the start of each month: on October 1, October through December are shown. October passes may already be reserved. Cancellations can release availability, so check again without assuming a last-minute pass will appear. Other library systems have their own release rules.
免费日、图书馆票、常设免费空间分开看: Distinguish free days, library passes, and normally free spaces
博物馆自己公布的免费日可能有居民、年龄或展览范围限制；图书馆通行证有独立的日期、: Museum free days can have residency, age, or exhibition limits. Library passes have separate date, group-size, and eligibility terms. Confirm that one option covers your visit rather than combining rules into an assumption that every exhibition is free for the whole family. Budget for transport, parking, and meals.
没有订到心仪的馆票时，把当日开放的本地图书馆当作短版计划：找一本与下次要去的地方: If the pass you wanted is unavailable, make an open local library the shorter plan: find a book about a future destination and check that branch’s exhibitions or activities. Register where the calendar requires it. Keep one such indoor alternative for each October weekend.

用所属图书馆的资格与可预约票种来安排，不按全湾区统一规则推算。: Plan around your own library’s eligibility and available passes rather than assuming one Bay Area-wide policy.
